name: ic_search_contacts
description: Search for contacts by name, email, or custom attributes. Returns contact ID, name, email, and metadata.

query.description: Search by email, name, or other field

name: ic_get_contact
description: Get full contact details by ID. Returns name, email, phone, attributes, tags, and conversation history.

name: ic_list_companies
description: List companies with pagination. Returns company ID, name, website, employee count, and custom attributes.
